I'm Pujitha Bokka, a BSc AI & Robotics student at Aditya Women's Degree College, Kakinada. My focus is on making intelligence tangible — through robotics projects, Python automation, and web interfaces.

03 — Projects

What I've built

Hands-on work in robotics, AI, and the web.

AI · Web App
ReLoop AI

An AI-powered waste identification and recycling platform that classifies plastic waste from images and suggests how to recycle it.

  • Built an AI-powered platform to identify and classify plastic waste through image-based analysis
  • Integrated Ollama with the open-weight Gemma 4 model for waste identification and intelligent recycling recommendations
  • Designed the application using Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Express.js and MongoDB
  • Implemented user authentication and waste management features to promote responsible recycling
Next.js TypeScript Tailwind CSS Express.js MongoDB Ollama Gemma 4
Robotics · Arduino
Bluetooth Controlled RC Car

A wireless RC car controlled from a smartphone via Bluetooth communication.

  • Built wireless control system using Bluetooth communication between Arduino Uno and smartphone
  • Implemented motor control and navigation logic using Arduino programming
  • Developed practical skills in robotics, embedded systems, and hardware integration
Arduino Uno Bluetooth C++ Motor Control Embedded Systems
Machine Learning · Python
House Price Predictor

An end-to-end ML project predicting house prices from area income, house age, rooms, and population, comparing Linear Regression against Random Forest.

  • Performed exploratory data analysis with pair plots and a correlation heatmap to uncover key price drivers
  • Trained and evaluated Linear Regression and Random Forest models using MAE, RMSE, and R² Score
  • Found Linear Regression outperformed Random Forest (R² of 0.918 vs 0.882), since the underlying relationships were largely linear
Python Pandas Scikit-learn Matplotlib Seaborn
